=== B. CRAFT FLOW (stage/taxonomy transitions, by station) ===

@cutting_board
  harvest       stage=plant, taxonomy=cuttable   -> GIVE (hands object)
  harvest_leaf  stage=plant, taxonomy=cuttable   -> GIVE (hands object)
  harvest_root  stage=plant, taxonomy=cuttable   -> GIVE (hands object)
  chop          taxonomy=leaf_plant, stage=leaf  -> stage=chopped
  choptatoes    taxonomy=potato, stage=harvested -> stage=sliced
  mince         taxonomy=leaf_plant, stage=chopped -> stage=minced

@mortar
  grind_organ   (any)                            -> stage=powder   [if meta.organ is grindable]
  grind         taxonomy=leaf_plant, stage=leaf  -> stage=powder
  over          taxonomy=leaf_plant, stage=leaf  -> stage=powder   [if fab.grind is over]
  grind_fine    taxonomy=leaf_plant, stage=chopped -> stage=powder
  over_fine     taxonomy=leaf_plant, stage=chopped -> stage=powder   [if fab.grind is over]
  grind_ultra   taxonomy=leaf_plant, stage=minced -> stage=powder
  over_ultra    taxonomy=leaf_plant, stage=minced -> stage=powder   [if fab.grind is over]
  poultice      taxonomy=leaf_plant, stage=powder, taxonomy=liquid -> stage=poultice

@alambic
  distill_water taxonomy=water                   -> (in place)   [if org.purity is potable]

@cauldron
  overcooked    (any)                            -> (in place)   [if fab.thermal is boiling]
  cooked_ok     (any)                            -> (in place)   [if fab.thermal is simmer]
  corrosif      (any)                            -> (in place)   [if fab.acidity is acidic & fab.stability is explosive]
  vomitif       (any)                            -> (in place)   [if org.bitter is bitter]
  boil_water    taxonomy=water                   -> (in place)   [if fab.thermal is boiling & org.purity is foul]
  perf          taxonomy=water                   -> stage=saline_iv   [if org.purity >= 7 & org.salty <= 2]
  brine         taxonomy=water                   -> stage=brine   [if org.purity >= 3 & org.salty >= 3]
  fry           (any)                            -> (in place)   [if fab.thermal is frying & org.viscosity is thick]
  makefries     taxonomy=potato, stage=sliced    -> stage=fried   [if fab.thermal is frying & org.viscosity is thick]

@field
  sprout        stage=seed                       -> stage=sprout   [if meta.elapsed_time >= 60]
  mature        stage=sprout                     -> stage=mature   [if meta.elapsed_time >= 240]
  harvest       stage=mature                     -> GIVE (hands object)
